There is a difference between negotiating from a position and negotiating after one, and it is the whole of the difference available here.\n\nWhether the other side is interested in the distinction is a separate matter, and not one this headquarters controls.Speculative counterfactualSpeculative. No German approach on these lines was made at this date. The Entente's willingness to treat with an unbeaten German army in September 1918 is not something the record can settle, and this ending does not pretend it can.Return to file
